Google Cloud CLI

  • General bug fixes.

Subscribe to these release notes at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce.

Breaking Changes

  • (Google Cloud CLI) Fixed an issue where --account overrode the ACCOUNT_NAME positional argument (formerly ACCOUNT) of gcloud auth print-access-token, print-identity-token, login, application-default login, and activate-service-account when specified after it. The positional argument now takes precedence. --account still applies when ACCOUNT_NAME is omitted.
  • (Cloud Billing) Fixed an issue where --account overrode the ACCOUNT_ID positional argument (formerly ACCOUNT) of gcloud billing accounts get-iam-policy, set-iam-policy, add-iam-policy-binding, and remove-iam-policy-binding when specified after it. The positional argument now takes precedence. ACCOUNT_ID is now always required. --account no longer replaces a missing ACCOUNT_ID.
  • (Compute Engine) Fixed an issue where --project overrode the PROJECT_ID positional argument of gcloud compute shared-vpc commands when specified after it. The positional argument now takes precedence. PROJECT_ID is now always required. --project no longer replaces a missing PROJECT_ID.

Google Cloud CLI

  • Fixed an issue where gcloud config config-helper crashed or overwrote stored credentials when auth/credential_file_override (CLOUDSDK_AUTH_CREDENTIAL_FILE_OVERRIDE) was set.
  • Added error details (such as the error reason and troubleshooting links) to the output for failed long-running operations.

AI

  • Fixed --system-labels flag of gcloud ai model-garden models deploy being ignored for Model Garden and Hugging Face models.

Agent Registry

  • Promoted gcloud agent-registry skill-encryption-spec to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud agent-registry skills revisions download to GA.
  • Fixed gcloud agent-registry skills create --payload so that the local ZIP archive is uploaded as the initial revision of the skill.

AlloyDB

  • Added support for the z4d-highmem-16-standardlssd machine-type in gcloud alloydb instances create and gcloud alloydb instances update.

App Lifecycle Manager

  • Added --with-default-evaluation flag to gcloud beta app-lifecycle-manager flags create to populate boolean flags with default variants (Enabled and Disabled) and default evaluation spec (defaultVariant: Disabled).

Artifact Registry

  • Renamed the URI positional argument of gcloud artifacts vulnerabilities list to ARTIFACT_URI in help text. Command syntax is unchanged.

Assured Workloads

  • Renamed the WORKLOAD_ID positional argument of gcloud assured workloads create to WORKLOAD in help text. Command syntax is unchanged.

BigLake

  • Promoted gcloud biglake iceberg views to beta. The create, delete, describe, get-iam-policy, list, set-iam-policy, and update commands are now available in beta.
  • Promoted gcloud biglake data-product-sharing unpublish to GA.

Cloud Backup DR

  • Updated gcloud backup-dr applied-auto-protection-policies list to return an error when --location=- is specified, because listing across all locations is not supported.

Cloud Composer

  • Added --rollback-image-version flag to gcloud composer environments update to roll back a Cloud Composer 3 environment to its previous image version.

Cloud Dataflow

  • Updated gcloud dataflow config-store-settings commands to accept project IDs in addition to project numbers for project-level settings.

Cloud IAM

  • Added --attribute-sync-interval flag to gcloud iam workforce-pools providers create-oidc and gcloud iam workforce-pools providers update-oidc, and --clear-attribute-sync-interval flag to gcloud iam workforce-pools providers update-oidc.

Cloud Run

  • Added support for gcloud beta run deploy --domain when property regional/endpoint_mode is set to regional-preferred.
  • Promoted regional endpoints support to GA for gcloud run deploy and gcloud run services, revisions, jobs, and worker-pools commands.
  • Promoted --scaling, --scaling-cpu-target, --clear-scaling-cpu-target, --min, and --max flags to gcloud beta run worker-pools deploy and gcloud beta run worker-pools update for configuring worker pool automatic and CPU utilization scaling.

Cloud SQL

  • Promoted gcloud sql blue-green-deployments to GA.
  • Promoted --msdtc-enabled and --msdtc-rpc-auth-mode flags of gcloud sql instances create and gcloud sql instances patch to GA.

Cloud Speech API

  • Promoted gcloud ml speech recognizers command group to beta.

Cloud Storage

  • Fixed an issue in gcloud storage buckets update where specifying --update-labels or --remove-labels multiple times only applied the last flag instead of merging all specified labels.

Cloud Tasks

  • Promoted gcloud tasks batch-create command to GA, which creates multiple tasks from a JSON or YAML file in a single batch operation.
  • Promoted --tasks-from-file and --failed-tasks-file on gcloud tasks delete to GA, which deletes multiple tasks in a single batch operation.
  • Deprecated --from-file on gcloud alpha/beta tasks delete; use --tasks-from-file instead.
  • Promoted the task-level retry flags (--max-attempts, --max-retry-duration, --min-backoff, --max-backoff, and --max-doublings) on gcloud tasks create-http-task and gcloud tasks create-app-engine-task to GA. These flags override the queue-level retry configuration for an individual task.

Cluster Director

  • Promoted --existing-instances flag of gcloud cluster-director clusters create and --add-existing-instances and --remove-existing-instances flags of gcloud cluster-director clusters update to beta to support importing existing Compute Engine instances into clusters.
  • Added resourcePolicyConfig to --slurm-node-sets flag of gcloud beta cluster-director clusters create and --add-slurm-node-sets and --update-slurm-node-sets flags of gcloud beta cluster-director clusters update to support configuring the accelerator topology of Slurm node sets.

Compute Engine

  • Promoted PASSTHROUGH_LOAD_BALANCER_AVAILABILITY_GROUP0 and PASSTHROUGH_LOAD_BALANCER_AVAILABILITY_GROUP1 values of the --purpose flag of gcloud compute addresses create to GA.
  • Promoted --purpose flag of gcloud compute public-delegated-prefixes create to GA.
  • Promoted --network-attachment and --service-class-id flags of gcloud compute addresses create to GA.
  • Promoted Global External Passthrough Network Load Balancing (EXTERNAL_PASSTHROUGH load-balancing scheme) support in gcloud compute forwarding-rules to GA.
  • Promoted Global External Passthrough Network Load Balancing (EXTERNAL_PASSTHROUGH load-balancing scheme) support in gcloud compute backend-services to GA.
  • Promoted imageOptimizationPolicy support in HttpRouteAction to GA for gcloud compute url-maps import, gcloud compute url-maps export, and gcloud compute url-maps validate.
  • Updated gcloud compute ssh to print status messages describing SSH key generation, public key upload, private key login, and temporary OS Login certificate cleanup.

Config Connector

  • Updated Google Cloud Config Connector to version 1.161.0. See Config Connector Overview for more details https://cloud.google.com/config-connector/docs/overview.

Container

  • Added bmsai option to --confidential-node-type flag in gcloud container clusters create, clusters create-auto, node-pools create, and node-pools update commands.

Design Center

  • Added gcloud design-center spaces application-templates export command to export IaC for an application template.
  • Added gcloud design-center spaces application-templates revisions export command to export IaC for an application template revision.

Kubernetes Engine

  • Added --enable-cluster-scale-to-zero and --cluster-scale-to-zero-delay flags to gcloud container clusters create, gcloud container clusters create-auto, and gcloud container clusters update to configure cluster scale-to-zero.

Workspace Add Ons

  • Added gcloud beta workspace-add-ons chat-app-config command group to view and update the Google Chat app configuration of a Google Cloud project.
  • Added gcloud beta workspace-add-ons deployments command group and gcloud beta workspace-add-ons get-authorization command, which match their GA versions.

Subscribe to these release notes at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce.

Breaking Changes

  • (App Lifecycle Manager) Updated --evaluation-spec flag of gcloud beta app-lifecycle-manager flags create and gcloud beta app-lifecycle-manager flags update to use defaultVariant, defaultAllocation, variantId, and allocationId instead of deprecated defaultTarget and target.

Google Cloud CLI

  • Made bundled Python a required component on Windows (x86 and x86_64). gcloud components update and gcloud components install now install it if it is missing.

Agent Identity

  • Promoted gcloud agent-identity auth-providers authorizations get-iam-policy, gcloud agent-identity auth-providers authorizations set-iam-policy, gcloud agent-identity auth-providers authorizations add-iam-policy-binding, gcloud agent-identity auth-providers authorizations remove-iam-policy-binding, and gcloud agent-identity auth-providers authorizations test-iam-permissions to GA.
  • Added --xaa-auth-provider-id-token-input-jag, --xaa-auth-provider-id-token-input-jag-additional-claims, --xaa-auth-provider-client-secret-id, --xaa-auth-provider-client-secret, --xaa-auth-provider-client-assertion-jwt-id, --xaa-auth-provider-custom-issuer-token-url, --xaa-auth-provider-custom-issuer, --xaa-auth-provider-additional-parameters, --connector-reference-auth-provider, and --connector-reference-auth-provider-authorization-details flags to gcloud agent-identity auth-providers create and gcloud agent-identity auth-providers update to configure Cross-App Access and Connector Reference auth providers.

AlloyDB

  • Added --[no-]enable-psc-auto-dns and --[no-]enable-psc-auto-connection-policy flags to gcloud alloydb instances create, gcloud alloydb instances create-secondary, and gcloud alloydb instances update to control automatic creation of DNS records and service connection policies for Private Service Connect (PSC) auto connections.

App Lifecycle Manager

  • Added --application-template-component, --application-template-component-revision, --composite-ref-application-template, and --composite-ref-revision flags to gcloud beta app-lifecycle-manager unit-kinds create and update.
  • Added --clear-application-template-component to gcloud beta app-lifecycle-manager unit-kinds update.
  • Promoted gcloud app-lifecycle-manager command group to GA.

Audit Manager

  • Added --parameter-overrides flag to gcloud audit-manager audit-reports generate, gcloud audit-manager audit-scopes generate, and gcloud audit-manager audit-schedules create to override parameters of parameterized cloud controls.

BigLake

  • Added --snowflake-user-identity-federation-role flag to gcloud beta biglake iceberg catalogs create and gcloud beta biglake iceberg catalogs update to support user identity federation for Snowflake federated catalogs.

BigQuery

  • Added a build status guidance message to bq query output when creating or replacing a Python user-defined function (UDF) via DDL.
  • Fixed an issue where specifying a regional endpoint (--api) for BigQuery or BigQuery Reservation commands could fail to load the bundled discovery document or crash on empty server discovery responses.
  • Added build status columns for Python user-defined functions in bq show --routine.
  • Added --condition_expression, --condition_title, and --condition_description flags in bq mk --reservation_assignment and bq update --reservation_assignment.
  • Removed the deprecated --multi_region_auxiliary flag from bq mk --reservation and bq mk --capacity_commitment, and the multiRegionAuxiliary column from reservation and capacity commitment output.
  • Updated the bundled yaml (PyYAML) dependency to package the Python 3 library directly and removed the legacy Python 2 compatibility shim.

Cloud Backup DR

  • Promoted gcloud backup-dr restore-templates command group to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud backup-dr restore-template-executions command group to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud backup-dr restore-verification-plans command group to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud backup-dr restore-verification-plan-associations command group to GA.

Cloud Bigtable

  • Rebuild with go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk 1.45.0 to fix CVE-2026-81870.

Cloud Bigtable Emulator

  • Rebuild cbt-emulator with go 1.26.9.

Cloud IAM

  • Added --actor-token-field-name and --actor-token-type flags and support for combining --credential-source-file with --credential-cert-path to gcloud iam workload-identity-pools create-cred-config to enable certificate-bound OAuth 2.0 token exchanges and actor token delegation.

Cloud Key Management Service

  • Updated gcloud kms locations list to include the HSM_SINGLE_TENANT_AVAILABLE column in the default table output.

Cloud Memorystore

  • Added ipVersion key to --endpoints flag of gcloud beta memorystore instances create to support IPv6 Private Service Connect auto-created endpoints.

Cloud Run

  • Added --[no-]ambient-networking and --ambient-scope flags for Cloud Run services, allowing users to enable ambient networking and choose a regional (default) or global scope. These flags are available in gcloud beta run deploy, gcloud beta run services update, and gcloud beta run multi-region-services update.

Cloud Shell

  • Deprecated gcloud cloud-shell get-mount-command. It will be removed in a future release.

Cloud Spanner

  • Added gcloud alpha spanner databases wait-for-reencryption to wait for background CMEK re-encryption to finish.
  • gcloud spanner databases update now provides instructions to wait until background re-encryption finishes when using the --kms-keys or --clear-kms-keys flags.

Cloud Storage

  • Fixed an issue with gcloud storage rsync on Windows where incorrect file sorting caused unchanged files to be re-copied or deleted.

Cloud Workstations

  • Promoted --disk-provisioned-iops and --disk-provisioned-throughput flags of gcloud workstations configs create and gcloud workstations configs update to GA.

Cluster Director

  • Added gcloud cluster-director clusters export and gcloud cluster-director clusters import commands to export and import Cluster Director cluster configurations.
  • Fixed an issue in gcloud cluster-director clusters update where startupScript, labels, and bootDisk values specified under computeInstance in --update-slurm-node-sets were ignored.
  • Promoted --managed-instance-groups flag of gcloud cluster-director clusters create and --add-managed-instance-groups, --update-managed-instance-groups, and --remove-managed-instance-groups flags of gcloud cluster-director clusters update to beta to support configuring Compute Engine managed instance group orchestration on clusters.

Compute Engine

  • Promoted --svsm-config flag to GA in gcloud compute instances create, gcloud compute instances bulk create, gcloud compute instances create-with-container, and gcloud compute instance-templates create.
  • Added support for regional backend services to --service-lb-policy flag of gcloud compute backend-services create.
  • Promoted --linked-custom-hardware flag of gcloud compute routers add-bgp-peer to beta.
  • Promoted --require-specific-reservation flag in gcloud compute reservations update to GA.
  • Promoted --content-type, --http-status, --backend-service, and --backend-bucket flags to GA in gcloud compute url-maps invalidate-cdn-cache to support cache invalidation by the new matchers.
  • Updated --host flag in gcloud compute url-maps invalidate-cdn-cache to support wildcard hostnames (e.g. *.example.com).

Config Connector

  • Updated Google Cloud Config Connector to version 1.160.0. See Config Connector Overview for more details https://cloud.google.com/config-connector/docs/overview.

Database Migration

  • Added --schemas-filter, --tables-filter, --excluded-schemas-filter, and --excluded-tables-filter flags to gcloud database-migration migration-jobs create and update commands to support schema- and table-level object filtering and exclusion.

Device Run

  • Added --target-app, --pre-target-apps, and --post-target-apps flags to gcloud beta device-run sessions submit instrumentation to specify the application under test and the applications to install before and after it.
  • Deprecated --apps flag of gcloud beta device-run sessions submit instrumentation. Use --target-app, --pre-target-apps, and --post-target-apps instead.

Eventarc

  • Fixed issue where gcloud eventarc triggers list failed when listing triggers without event filters.

GKE Hub

  • Added --auto-rollout-scope and --ignored-clusters-selector flags to gcloud container fleet|hub rolloutsequences create and update commands.
  • Added --clear-ignored-clusters-selector flag to gcloud container fleet|hub rolloutsequences update command.
  • Added --read-only flag to gcloud container fleet|hub memberships register to register a non-GKE cluster with a READ_ONLY membership type, which skips cluster mutations and the Connect agent installation.

Kubernetes Engine

  • Added --default-compute-class flag to gcloud container clusters create and gcloud container clusters update.
  • Updated gcloud container clusters create to reject more flags that only configure the default node pool, such as --boot-disk-kms-key and --workload-metadata, when used with --num-nodes=0.
  • Fixed gcloud container clusters describe suggesting a node upgrade for clusters that have no node pools.
  • Updated gcloud container clusters upgrade to fail with a clear error when the cluster has no node pools and neither --master nor --node-pool is specified.
  • Updated gcloud container clusters update to fail with a clear error when --enable-autoscaling is specified without --node-pool for a cluster that has no node pools.
  • Updated gcloud container clusters resize to fail with a clear error for clusters that have no node pools.
  • Updated gcloud container clusters list and gcloud container clusters create to show 0 in the NUM_NODES column for clusters without nodes, instead of leaving it empty.
  • Updated default kubectl from 1.35.9 to 1.36.6.
  • Removed kubectl version 1.31 as extended support has expired.
  • Additional kubectl versions:
    • 1.32.13
    • 1.33.13
    • 1.34.13
    • 1.35.10
    • 1.36.6
    • 1.37.2
  • Fixed an issue where gcloud beta container clusters create and gcloud alpha container clusters create with --stack-type=ipv6 required --enable-ip-alias for --enable-private-nodes and rejected --no-enable-ip-alias. IP aliases do not apply to IPv6-only clusters, so --no-enable-ip-alias is now ignored with a warning.

Looker

  • Promoted --workforce-auth-enabled and --google-auth-enabled flags to GA for gcloud looker instances create and gcloud looker instances update.

Model Armor

  • Added --filter-version-selector and --filter-version-selector-alias flags to gcloud model-armor templates create and gcloud model-armor templates update.

Network Connectivity

  • Promoted --export-psc-published-services-and-regional-google-apis and --export-psc-global-google-apis flags of gcloud network-connectivity hubs create and gcloud network-connectivity hubs update commands to GA.

Network Management

  • Added --source-datastream-private-connection flag to gcloud network-management connectivity-tests.

Network Services

  • Added gcloud beta network-services express-links which manages Network Services ExpressLink resources.

Oracle Database

  • Added gcloud oracle-database cloud-vm-clusters enable-identity-connector, gcloud oracle-database cloud-vm-clusters disable-identity-connector, gcloud oracle-database exadb-vm-clusters enable-identity-connector and gcloud oracle-database exadb-vm-clusters disable-identity-connector commands to manage the Workload Identity Connector of Exadata and Exascale VM Clusters.
  • Added --identity-connector-disabled flag to gcloud oracle-database cloud-vm-clusters create and gcloud oracle-database exadb-vm-clusters create to opt out of provisioning the Workload Identity Connector.

Secure Source Manager

  • Added --enable-vulnerability-scanning argument to gcloud source-manager repos create and gcloud source-manager repos update commands.

Service Health

  • Added gcloud beta service-health impacts command group to list and describe asset impacts under a project.

Subscribe to these release notes at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce.

Breaking Changes

  • (Cloud Datastore Emulator) Removed support for running the Datastore emulator (gcloud beta emulators datastore start) in environment with Java versions prior to 25. Users can upgrade to Java 25 or above to continue using the latest Datastore emulator. Alternatively, users can use previous gcloud CLI versions to continue using the Datastore emulator with Java 21 support.
  • (Cloud Firestore Emulator) Removed support for running the Firestore emulator (gcloud emulators firestore start) in environment with Java versions prior to 25. Users can upgrade to Java 25 or above to continue using the latest Firestore emulator. Alternatively, users can use previous gcloud CLI versions to continue using the previous Firestore emulator with Java 21 support.
  • (Docker) Removed the system Python and C compiler from the Debian-based Docker images. gcloud, gsutil and bq now always run on the bundled Python, on both linux/amd64 and linux/arm64. The removed packages differ by image:
    • :latest, :slim, :debian_component_based: python3, python3-dev, python3-pip, python3-crcmod and gcc.
    • :emulators: python3 and python3-crcmod.
    • :stable: python3-dev and python3-crcmod, on linux/arm64 only.
  • (Docker) Setting CLOUDSDK_PYTHON=python3 (or CLOUDSDK_GSUTIL_PYTHON / CLOUDSDK_BQ_PYTHON) in these images now makes every gcloud, gsutil or bq call fail, because there is no python3 on PATH. Unset it to use the bundled Python.
  • (Docker) If your workflow requires a system Python, install it on top of the image, for example with apt-get install python3. This does not change which Python gcloud uses. If you need to compile C extensions, also install build-essential python3-dev.

Google Cloud CLI

  • Changed the Java dependency of the google-cloud-cli-datastore-emulator, google-cloud-cli-firestore-emulator, google-cloud-cli-pubsub-emulator, google-cloud-cli-app-engine-java, and google-cloud-cli-bqms deb and rpm packages from a full JDK to a headless JRE, preferring Java 25. The Datastore and Firestore emulator packages now require Java 25 or later.

Agent Registry

  • Removed --scanning-state flag from gcloud agent-registry skills create and gcloud agent-registry skills update. Use --scanning-policy instead.

AlloyDB

  • Updated AlloyDB Auth Proxy installation instructions in gcloud alloydb connect to v1.17.2.
  • Added --connection-pooling-authproxy-pooler-scaling-type flag to gcloud beta alloydb instances create, gcloud beta alloydb instances create-secondary, and gcloud beta alloydb instances update.
  • Promoted the following flags to GA on gcloud alloydb instances create and gcloud alloydb instances update:
    • --enable-autoscaler
    • --autoscaler-max-node-count
    • --autoscaler-cool-down-period-seconds
    • --autoscaler-target-cpu-usage
    • --autoscaler-set-schedule
    • --autoscaler-schedule-cron-exp
    • --autoscaler-schedule-duration-seconds
    • --autoscaler-schedule-time-zone
    • --autoscaler-schedule-min-node-count
    • --autoscaler-schedule-description
  • Promoted the following flags to GA on gcloud alloydb instances update:
    • --autoscaler-delete-schedule
    • --autoscaler-disable-schedule
    • --autoscaler-enable-schedule
  • Added --autoscaler-target-connections-count flag to gcloud alloydb instances create and gcloud alloydb instances update.

App Engine

  • Updated the Java SDK to version 5.2.0 build from the open source project https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/appengine-java-standard/releases/tag/v5.2.0.
  • Added --from-image and --destination-repository flags to gcloud beta app migrate-to-run for App Engine Standard environment.
  • Updated gcloud beta app migrate-to-run --from-image to show the reason returned by the App Engine Admin API when exporting the image fails.
  • Added support for the vpc_access configuration in app.yaml to gcloud app deploy, enabling Direct VPC egress for App Engine standard environment.

App Hub

  • Added MULTI_REGIONAL choice to --scope-type flag of gcloud apphub applications create.

Artifact Registry

  • Fixed an issue in gcloud artifacts attachments download where attachment file names were not validated before writing to --destination.

Beyondcorp

  • Added --dispatch-info-output-type flag to gcloud beyondcorp security-gateways create and gcloud beyondcorp security-gateways update, and upstream dispatchInfo configuration to gcloud beyondcorp security-gateways applications create and gcloud beyondcorp security-gateways applications update to configure delegated dispatch info headers.
  • Removed gcloud beta beyondcorp app and gcloud beta beyondcorp client-connector command groups.

BigLake

  • Added --kms-key flag to gcloud beta biglake hive catalogs create, and --kms-key and --clear-kms-key flags to gcloud beta biglake hive catalogs update to support customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK).
  • Added --workday-api-client-client-id flag to gcloud beta biglake iceberg catalogs create and gcloud beta biglake iceberg catalogs update to support Workday OIDC authentication.

Cloud Backup DR

  • Removed default value (-) for --location flag in gcloud beta backup-dr applied-auto-protection-policies list. --location flag is now required.
  • Promoted gcloud backup-dr applied-auto-protection-policies to GA.
  • Fixed an issue where gcloud backup-dr backup-plans update --backup-rules-from-file failed with update mask is required when the file contained an empty backup-rules list.
  • Fixed an issue where gcloud backup-dr backup-plans update --backup-rules-from-file cleared --compute-instance-properties and --disk-properties when they were specified in the same command.
  • Promoted gcloud backup-dr applied-auto-protection-policies to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud backup-dr auto-protection-bindings to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud backup-dr auto-protection-policies commands to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud backup-dr binding-matching-resources to GA.

Cloud Bigtable

  • Added --automated-backup-keep-hot-duration flag to gcloud bigtable instances tables create, gcloud bigtable instances tables update, gcloud bigtable tables create, and gcloud bigtable tables update to create hot automated backups that remain hot for the specified duration before transitioning to standard backups.
  • Added --clear-automated-backup-keep-hot-duration flag to gcloud bigtable instances tables update and gcloud bigtable tables update to stop creating hot automated backups.
  • Added --avro-schema-path flag to gcloud bigtable schema-bundles create and gcloud bigtable schema-bundles update.

Cloud Dataplex

  • Added --custom-instructions flag to gcloud dataplex datascans create data-documentation and --custom-instructions and --clear-custom-instructions flags to gcloud dataplex datascans update data-documentation to support specifying or clearing custom instructions that guide data documentation generation.
  • Added --sql-dialect flag to gcloud dataplex datascans create data-documentation and gcloud dataplex datascans update data-documentation commands to specify the SQL dialect to use in generated SQL queries.

Cloud Dataproc

  • Added --scheduling-timeout and --requested-run-duration flags to gcloud dataproc clusters create for creating Dynamic Workload Scheduler (DWS) scheduled clusters.

Cloud Datastream

  • Fixed an issue where gcloud datastream private-connections create silently dropped user-supplied --labels.

Cloud Firestore Emulator

  • Release Cloud Firestore emulator v1.23.0
    • Added support for Datastore merge join and multiple inequality index selection with --require-indexes in Datastore mode
    • Added support for the add_window_fields stage in the Firestore Pipelines API with the sum, average, count, minimum, maximum, first, last, array_agg, array_agg_distinct, and rank window functions
    • Allowed Enterprise data types for all database editions
    • Fixed transaction conflict detection for concurrent writes against transactional queries
    • Fixed ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException on incomplete Firestore Rules permission traces
    • Populated accurate MoreResultsType for Datastore mode queries and fixed Pipeline DML edge cases
    • Updated minimum required Java JRE version to 25

Cloud Infrastructure Manager

  • Updated gcloud infra-manager deployments apply to display a warning when --tf-version-constraint or the deployment configuration specifies a paid Terraform version (1.6.0 or later).

Cloud Key Management Service

  • Added support for ECDH key encapsulation mechanism algorithms: kem-ecdh-p256 and kem-ecdh-p384.

Cloud Run

  • Added --public flag for Cloud Run services, allowing users to make a service public by disabling invoker IAM checks and Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP). This flag is available in gcloud beta run deploy, gcloud beta run services update, and gcloud beta run multi-region-services update.

Cloud SQL

  • Added gcloud sql instances reconcile-networking to reconcile Private Service Connect (PSC) DNS networking configuration for a Cloud SQL instance.

Cloud Shell

  • Updated gcloud cloud-shell scp to support passwordless authentication over the Cloud Shell TCP tunnel.
  • Updated gcloud cloud-shell ssh to skip uploading an SSH public key when connecting with passwordless authentication.

Cloud Workstations

  • Added --direct-access-ports flag to gcloud beta workstations clusters create command.
  • Added --direct-access-ports flag to gcloud beta workstations clusters update command.

Compute Engine

  • Fixed an issue where gcloud compute commands omitted troubleshooting documentation links from operation error messages.
  • Promoted --reservation-subblock flag of gcloud compute hosts describe, gcloud compute hosts list, gcloud compute reservations hosts describe, and gcloud compute reservations hosts list to GA and beta.

Firebase Test Lab

  • Deprecated gcloud firebase test command group. Firebase Test Lab is deprecated and will be fully shut down on September 30, 2027. To maintain your testing workflows, you can migrate to the Developer Device Platform on Google Cloud. See the Developer Device Platform Migration Guide (https://docs.cloud.google.com/developer-device-platform/device-run/migrate) and FAQ (https://docs.cloud.google.com/developer-device-platform/troubleshooting) for more details.

Kubernetes Engine

  • Added --enable-dataplane-v2 flag to gcloud container clusters update to initiate GKE Dataplane V2 migration for clusters.
  • Added --datapath-provider flag to gcloud container node-pools update to update the datapath provider for a node pool.
  • Promoted --enable-ambient-networking flag to GA for gcloud container clusters create, gcloud container clusters create-auto, and gcloud container clusters update.

Network Security

  • Updated SecurityProfile and SecurityProfileGroup YAML schemas to support WildFire Analysis in beta and GA.

Subscribe to these release notes at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce.

Breaking Changes
